The provided Riven reference is used to define Riven's appearance.

Use the provided valley reference image as the environment reference.

Preserve the wide green valley, clear dirt road, open grassland, distant forest, surrounding mountains, natural daylight, and grounded realistic atmosphere shown in the reference.

The scene takes place on the dirt road shown in the environment reference.

The environment is peaceful and empty.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.
16:9 cinematic widescreen.
Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.
Natural fast running movement.
Realistic body momentum.

No slow motion.

No subtitles.
No captions.
No text.
No watermark.
No logo.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

Riven is beginning her journey into the outside world.

She is running at full speed along the dirt road through the valley toward the distant forest.

This is not a battle.

Riven is not fighting anyone.

Nobody is chasing her.

There are no other characters in the scene.

Keep the action simple and focused entirely on Riven running forward.


=== SCENES ===

Begin with a wide cinematic establishing shot of the peaceful valley.

Show the dirt road crossing the open grassland toward the distant forest and mountains.

Riven is not visible in this opening shot.

Cut to a close shot of boots running quickly along the dirt road.

The footsteps are fast and powerful.

Small amounts of dust rise naturally beneath the boots.

The camera follows the running feet.

Gradually pull the camera back.

Reveal that the person running is Riven.

Riven is running at full speed along the dirt road.

Her movement is natural, athletic, and continuous.

Her hair and clothing move naturally with her running.

Her large sword remains securely carried with her.

Riven continues running forward along the road toward the distant forest.

She does not stop.

She does not look back.

She does not draw her sword.

End with a wider cinematic shot showing Riven continuing to run along the road through the vast valley.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Riven is still traveling alone through the valley.

She is running forward along the dirt road toward the distant forest and the larger world beyond her home.

Her journey has begun.

Energetic.
Free.
Adventurous.
Optimistic.

The scene should feel like the beginning of a new journey.

the peaceful landscape,
fast running footsteps,
Riven is revealed,
Riven continues running forward.、16:9
